name: Saint Nicholas
history: Bishop of Myra in Asia Minor, remembered for secretly giving three bags of gold to save three poor girls from ruin by throwing them through a window at night. From that hidden charity came Santa Claus.
prayer: O God, You who made the holy Bishop Nicholas renowned for countless miracles, grant, we beseech You, that by his merits and prayers we may be saved from the fires of hell. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
